ankleSetup: Ikara magũrũ mathiĩ mbere. Thindĩka mathara mbere, rĩrĩa ũmaguucie nyuma.
armLibraryCopy: Mũongozo wa kũinamũra njara na kũkinya ũraihu bwa kĩega na ũgitũma ũgitigĩrĩre.
armSetup: Tũma mwĩrĩ wa igũrũ wonwe. Mwana ainamũre njara ikinye balloon zone.
balanceGameSub: Ikara wĩ mũrũngarũ ũthondeke mĩceng'a ya balance.
balanceLibraryCopy: Mũongozo wa kũĩthithia balance na ũteithio na ũgitũma ũgitigĩrĩre.
balanceSetup: Mwĩrĩ wothe wonwo. Mwana aikare arĩ mũrũngarũ, mũreri arĩ hakuhĩ.
bridgeSetup: Koma na mũgongo, maru makunjĩte. Inũra kĩuno mpole ũthondeke daraja.
bridgeSub: Inũra daraja nĩ ũndũ wa mboti.
catchSetup: Ta mpira mũororo mpola ũrĩ ũraihu bwa gĩthũri. Mwana akamie na moko jomairĩ.
clapSetup: Rora kamera. Hũra makĩ mbere ya gĩthũri o rĩrĩa target yagĩka.
crawlSetup: Thithia handũ harĩ na kĩrĩro gĩĩthĩ. Mũkũrie akambate athiĩ kĩnyari kĩake kĩendwa.
dailyPlan: Mũbango wa tiba wa o mũthenya
dailyPlanCopy: Thiria kipindi kĩmwe kĩa njara, kĩmwe kĩa kũgũrũ, na kĩmwe kĩa balance na ũteithio bwa mũrũgamĩrĩri.
drawSetup: Tũmĩra crayon karatasĩ-inĩ, kana rũmĩrĩria mĩhiano rĩera-inĩ na kĩara.
dressSetup: Tũmĩra bao ya kwĩmenyera ĩrĩ na mabũtũni manene na zip.
feedSetup: Ikĩra bead nini igũrũ rĩa gĩciko. Mwana agĩtware atĩkĩgũithia.
gaitLibraryCopy: Mũongozo wa gũthi na ũteithio na kwĩthithia matambuko.
gaitSetup: Theria njĩra ĩrĩ na ũgitĩri. Taatha mpole ũthiĩ mbere ũkĩteithio.
gripSetup: Tũmĩra sponge mũororo kana stress ball. Kamũra, gwata sekondi 3, ũrekie.
headSetup: Teithia mwana aikare. Thamia kĩndũ kĩrathaka mpole nĩguo akĩrũmĩrĩre na maitho.
headSub: Rũmĩrĩra nyota ĩrathama na maitho maku.
langFallbackNote: UI ĩgũtũmĩra Kĩngeretha rĩrĩa mbandũra cia {lang} cirĩ kũthondekwa.
legGameSub: Gũra kuelekea nyota ya mwena ĩrathaka.
legLibraryCopy: Mwongozo wa PT: rugama na kũgũrũ kũrĩa kũrĩ na hinya mũnini, gwata rũthingo rwa kwĩgwata, ũcoka ũte kĩra kĩngĩ. Mũrũgamĩrĩri atethagĩria kuma nyuma angĩba nĩbĩbataire.
legSetup: Rũgama na kũgũrũ kũrĩ na hinya mũnini, ũkĩnyiita raili. Gũra nyota na kũgũrũ kũngĩ.
marchSetup: Nyita gĩtĩ gĩkũteithie. Inũra rũũ rwa kũgũrũ rũkinye ũrĩa kĩuno kĩrĩ, ũkĩringana na mũgambo.
marchSub: Tambũra kũringana na mũgambo wa ngoma.
midlineSetup: Ikĩra target mwena ũngĩ wa mwĩrĩ. Mwana atambũrũkie guoko akĩringa midline.
pinchSetup: Ikĩra beads/pom-poms thĩinĩ wa tray. Mwana amine na thumb na kĩara.
reachSetup: Ikĩra kĩndũ kĩa kwĩthaka kĩa mpũrũ kĩraihu kĩa kĩega. Mwana akinye kwaku.
safetyNote: Rĩka angĩkorwo kwĩ na rũũru, kĩchwa gĩkũrũgũma, kana kũnogera kũrĩa gũtari kwa kawaida.
sensorySetup: Rĩkĩria mĩgwato 3 (mũororo, mũkarara, wa mabũmbũ). Mwana agwate o ũmwe.
sensorySub: Gwata kĩrĩ mũororo, kĩũmũ, na kĩrĩ na mabũmbũ.
shoulderSetup: Ikara kana ũrũgama wĩ mũrũngarũ. Thingithia marũ mabega mbere, igũrũ, nyuma, na thĩ.
simonSetup: Mũreri augage mwĩthiĩre. Mwana athiĩ ta ũguo aki Simon oona augĩte.
sitstandSetup: Ikara gĩtĩ kĩrĩ na hinya, magũrũ marĩ thĩ. Rũgama mpole, rĩrĩa ũikare rĩngĩ.
squatSetup: Rũgama na magũrũ matari kũmbana, ta ũraaya wa mabega, unyite raili, ũkunje maru kanini, rĩrĩa ũrũgame.
stretchSetup: Nyũrũra nyama irĩ na ũkũũ mpole ũkĩteithia. Nyita o kũnyũrũra sekondi 15–20.
trackSetup: Mutwe ũtikanainuke. Tĩĩa kĩndũ gĩkũthiĩ mpola na maitho aki.
trunkSetup: Ikara wĩ mũrũngarũ. Garũra mwĩrĩ wa igũrũ mwena wa ũmotho na wa ũrĩo mpole.
videoPlaceholder: Video yaku ya kwĩrira ĩkooneka aja.
